purpose: Isolate whether the unblocked long-goal stall is caused by Nav2 approach commands falling below the Ackermann plant's actuation floor
hypothesis: If low approach speed is the primary cause, changing only FollowPath.min_approach_linear_velocity from its default to 0.30 m/s will allow the 5 m unblocked goal to succeed within 45 s.
inclusion_rule: Calibration only; do not add to the primary explanation sample regardless of outcome.
mismatch_rule: Retain a timeout/failure as falsifying evidence against the simple low-speed-floor hypothesis; do not tune the same run.
causal_limit: A successful parameter intervention would support a controller-plant compatibility mechanism for this configuration, not a general physical-causation claim.
